title: 不可预约时段
Unavailable times
intro: 临时休息或另有安排时，选择日期与时间封闭。已确认的预约会受到保护。
Block a date and time for a break or other plans. Confirmed reservations are protected.
empty: 暂无临时封闭时段。每周营业时间仍按营业设置执行。
No temporary blocks. Weekly opening hours still apply.
new: 有新的到店预约，请到预约列表查看。
A new studio reservation is waiting. Open your reservation list.
noteNotification: 工作台打开时持续检查；浏览器提醒需你允许通知。
Checked while the desk is open. Browser alerts require your permission.
unsupported: 此浏览器暂不支持系统通知，工作台内仍会提醒。
System notifications are unavailable in this browser. In-desk alerts still work.
denied: 浏览器未允许通知；可在网站权限中开启。工作台内提醒仍可用。
Notifications are not allowed. Enable them in site permissions; in-desk alerts remain available.
